dedupe_keys.name: eefit reconnaissance photos and videos from the 2016 amatrice italy earthquake

description: This collection holds photographs and videos from earthquake damage surveys of the village of Amatrice in central Italy after the magnitude 6.2 earthquake of 24 August 2016. They were gathered by the Earthquake Engineering Field Investigation Team (EEFIT) mission of 4 to 15 October 2016, funded by NERC grant NE/P01660X/1, and are held by the British Geological Survey's National Geoscience Data Centre; the data.gov.uk entry dates from February 2020. The mission looked at ground surface effects, structural damage to masonry buildings and bridges, and the performance of reinforced concrete structures and infrastructure. Coverage: Amatrice and its surroundings. Access: BGS NGDC deposited data search. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): BGS NGDC Terms and Conditions (deposited data; no open licence named on the pages read). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the file list and survey coordinates were not visible on the pages read. Simulation uses: damage classification, fragility validation for masonry and concrete buildings, and post-event reconnaissance teaching. Related records: the STEER structural reconnaissance series and the Torre del Greco survey case study.
